prompt.title: Get real-time alerts
prompt.text: New order, order ready, team message: be notified even when the app is closed.

denied.title: Notifications blocked
denied.text: Re-enable them in the site settings (padlock in the address bar). Meanwhile, the app checks for updates every 30 s while open.

unsupported.title: Push notifications unavailable
unsupported.text: This browser doesn't support push notifications (on iPhone: add the app to your home screen). The app checks for updates every 30 s while open.

failed.title: Push subscription failed
failed.text: Notifications are allowed but subscribing failed (network or server not configured). The app checks for updates every 30 s while open.
